accepted_steps.derivation: Represent an urn state as an ordered triple (r,b,g) of nonnegative integers, where r,b,g are the current numbers of red, blue, and green balls. The initial givens give r=3, b=2, g=1, so S0=(3,2,1). Let T=r+b+g be the total number of balls in a state; for any reachable state T>0. Because each round draws one ball uniformly from the current urn, the conditional one-step draw probabilities are P(R|r,b,g)=r/T, P(B|r,b,g)=b/T, and P(G|r,b,g)=g/T. Here P(B|...)=0 if b=0 and P(G|...)=0 if g=0, consistent with the uniform rule. The prose update rules apply after the draw and before the next draw: if red is drawn, the drawn red is returned and one blue is added, so (r,b,g)->(r,b+1,g); if blue is drawn, the drawn blue is removed and one green is added, so (r,b,g)->(r,b-1,g+1); if green is drawn, the drawn green is returned and one red is added, so (r,b,g)->(r+1,b,g). Thus the one-step transition law is fully specified from S0. This step fixes notation, the initial state, and the one-step probabilities/updates only; it does not yet sum over six rounds or compute the sixth-draw probability.
accepted_steps.goal: Define state notation, initial urn S0=(3,2,1), and the one-step draw probabilities and update rules.
accepted_steps.result: S0=(3,2,1); for state (r,b,g) with T=r+b+g: R draw with prob r/T gives (r,b+1,g); B draw with prob b/T gives (r,b-1,g+1); G draw with prob g/T gives (r+1,b,g).
